pass_limit: closes without force; caps 1.85 +-0.2 mm proud and free; panel window aligned within 0.5 mm; nothing rattles; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Cell incoming inspection per lot
procedure: every cell: DMM on the plug (red lead on J2 pin 1 '+'), OCV; the plug latches in a Molex 53261-0271 sample and withdraws only with the latch pressed; one per lot: calipers with its PCM; run before the first cell is plugged (F-R9: the cells take 21 days to arrive)
pass_limit: 100% polarity correct; 100% of plugs latch; OCV 3.6-4.0 V as shipped; length and width with the PCM within the limit cell.json and DEC-27 set (52 x 36 x 4.5 mm, case.scad's worst case, today)
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d) and one 53261-0271 sample (LCSC, $0.13, 7d)

title: Button force and travel against a genuine DS Lite
procedure: kitchen scale (0.1 g) under the cap, press until the pill closes (DMM continuity); depth gauge or calipers for travel
pass_limit: force within +-30% of the genuine DS Lite measured the same way; travel within +-0.2 mm
needs: a printed case (VER-48) and a genuine DS Lite (owned), 0d

title: Pill-to-comb XY registration measured on the fit kit
procedure: ink the pills, press each button once on the board mock, measure the print against the comb centre (loupe, calipers); at CASE, when the fit kit is printed
pass_limit: every pill print centred within 0.9 mm of its comb centre
needs: a printed fit kit (CASE), 0d

title: BU-0 unpowered resistances to GND (TP1-TP4) and VBUS-VBAT
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM)
pass_limit: TP1 8.5-10 kohm (R38 10k in parallel with R14 10k + D3 + R15 100k, about 110 kohm when the meter forward-biases D3, and R43 100k + EN1's internal 285k: 8.95 kohm with D3 on, 9.75 kohm with it off); TP2, TP3 and TP4 > 1 kohm once the caps charge (TP3 above 1 kohm rules out a U2 BAT-to-pad bridge: DF-148); TP1 to TP3 > 10 kohm; none a short

title: BU-0 diode tests VBAT<->VSYS and VBUS<->VSYS
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM diode range)
pass_limit: TP3(+) to TP2: one diode drop, 0.4-0.8 V (U2's battery FET's body diode); TP2(+) to TP3: open or above 1.2 V; TP1(+) to TP2: open (U2's input switch blocks both ways); bringup.md step 0 to match (DEF-21)

title: BU-0 cell polarity at J2 before mating
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0; hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 2
pass_limit: red lead on J2 pin 1 '+', checked with a DMM, every cell
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d)

title: BU-1 USB only, no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 1: first power from the bench supply at 5.0 V with a 100 mA limit through a USB-C breakout, never a wall charger first (DF-101); USB power meter
pass_limit: VBUS 4.75-5.25 V; VSYS 4.30-4.50 V (U2's OUT); 3V3 3.23-3.37 V; input < 60 mA; RP2350 drive appears within 5 s; CHG_PG_N low
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d)

title: BU-2.1 all 20 buttons read, alone and together
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.1 with the self-test image: 16 through the 74HC165 chain (SR_PL GPIO19, SR_CLK GPIO29 through R65, SR_DATA GPIO30) at 1 MHz, Start and Select on GPIO2, 3, 4, 35
pass_limit: each contact reads pressed when shorted and released otherwise, in the bit order pinmap.md gives; any 4 at once read correctly; both Starts read on GPIO3 and GPIO2

title: BU-2.2/2.3 ADC7 and the charger's status pins
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md steps 2.2-2.3
pass_limit: ADC7 reads; CHG_STAT_N and CHG_PG_N read with the pull-downs off; CHG_PG_N low on USB

title: BU-2.4 SWD through J5 and J7
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.4
pass_limit: probe-rs attaches through J5 and through J7's pads; RTT or USB CDC text from the self-test (no UART connector since 86bf694)

title: BU-2.5 revision strap
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.5
pass_limit: REV3..REV0 = BOARD_REV (1) with pull-ups on
evidence: RETIRED in 86bf694: R48-R51 and the revision strap removed; BOARD_REV is on the silkscreen, read in the FAI (VER-109)

title: BU-3.1-3.3 panel init, ID, colour
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display steps 1-3
pass_limit: ID4 (0xD3) = 0x94 0x88 at <= 5 MHz; COLMOD 0x66 (18-bit: the ILI9488 takes no 16-bit colour over SPI); red, green, blue, white fills correct, no missing lines

title: BU-3.4 SPI write speed
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 4
pass_limit: 10 full 320 x 480 frames (461 kB each in 18-bit colour) of a checker pattern at 20 MHz (18.75 MHz from a 150 MHz clk_peri) with 0 corrupted pixels at the far edge; the reads at 6.7 MHz or less (trc 150 ns); the fastest clock that still shows 0 is recorded as an observation, never as the pass band (O-R1: a clock over 20 MHz is out of spec)

title: BU-3.5 backlight current, balance, step response, headroom
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 5; first light with JP2 cut and a DMM on mA across it
pass_limit: 80% duty: 99 +-5 mV on R52 and R53, within 3 mV of each other; at the firmware's highest duty: <= 120 mA total through JP2; at its minimum duty (18%, pinmap.md) each sink within +-25%; 18<->95% step: no ringing on the scope; a 3.5 V cell at the highest duty: drop <= 5%; USB plugged in while lit: no visible flash

title: BU-3.6 tearing-effect pulse
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 6
pass_limit: one pulse per frame, 60 Hz +-10%

title: BU-4 audio: level, carrier, wake, heat, noise
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 4; scope across SPK_P/SPK_N (two probes, A-B); thermocouple on U7
pass_limit: >= 0.35 W into 8 ohm (>= 4.75 V peak-to-peak) at 1 kHz on a 3.8 V cell; carrier >= 40 dB down; full output <= 150 ms after AMP_EN; U7 top <= 85 C after 10 min full scale on USB; no audible whine in silence

title: BU-5.1 off-state cell current
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.1: DMM across cut JP5 on its A range through turn-on, then the uA range with the device off (or a 0.1 ohm shunt on the scope); the uA range cannot pass the 0.75 A turn-on peak; with VER-146's TP1 reading
pass_limit: <= 30 uA at 25 C, cell 3.7-4.2 V, device off, no USB (designed: the 940k divider 4.5 uA, U2 from BAT, U7 in shutdown on the live VSYS, U3 off)

title: BU-5.2 charge current and CHG_OFF pause
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.2: DMM on its A range across cut JP5; log the current for 10 min at the start of CC with a thermocouple on U2's top (a voided exposed pad shows the current sliding as U2 passes 70 C: DF-08)
pass_limit: 242-295 mA into a cell at 3.6-3.9 V (R5 3.3k) and still >= 242 mA after 10 min with U2's top under ambient + 50 C; CHG_OFF high stops it within 1 s; low resumes

title: BU-5.3 ADC against a meter; CV at charge-done; bench-supply sweep
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.3; then the bench supply in place of the cell, 3.0-4.2 V in 0.1 V steps, with CHG_OFF (GPIO43) held high or 10 ohm 5 W across the supply (most supplies cannot sink U2's 242-295 mA); record VBAT at each point
pass_limit: computed VBAT within 20 mV of the DMM at 3.50 V after calibration (VER-155) and within 50 mV elsewhere above 3.6 V; VBAT 4.158-4.242 V when CHG_STAT_N goes high at the end of a charge
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference that session
needs: 10 ohm 5 W resistor and a 4.096 V reference breakout (LM4040 or REF3040, about $3, 7d)

title: BU-5.4 charger heat and the TS level
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4 (thermocouple on U2; DMM on TP7, the TS node)
pass_limit: TS within design_numbers.py tsband's band at the ambient read beside the board (about 0.70-1.04 V at 22 C; 0.75 V nominal holds only at 25 C: round 2's objection); after 10 min of charging in the closed case still >= 0.49 V (TH1 under 35 C: B3950 at 75 uA); U2's top under ambient + 50 C

title: BU-5.4a charge pauses outside the temperature window
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4a on unit 1 only (hair dryer, cold pack, thermocouple next to TH1); VER-135 is the per-unit TS check
pass_limit: pauses at VER-32's hot edge +-3 C rising (47 C nominal) and its cold edge +-3 C falling (3.5 C nominal); resumes in range

title: BU-5.5 unplug on the scope; 100 unplugs with a flash check
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.5; scope on TP4 (3V3) and TP2 (VSYS); the bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V with CHG_OFF held high or 10 ohm 5 W across it, so it stays at 3.50 V while USB is in; record VBAT at the trigger instant
pass_limit: VBAT at the trigger 3.50 +-0.03 V; VSYS never below VBAT - 0.10 V; 3V3 >= 3.135 V throughout; 100 unplugs with no reset and no flash CRC error

title: BU-5.6 hot plug with no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.6 (A-to-C cable from an always-on USB-A port)
pass_limit: VBUS at or under U2's OVP minimum less 0.2 V (as VER-12); VSYS <= 4.6 V; EN1 (U2 pin 6) <= 6.7 V; PWR_EN (TP6) <= 5.5 V; bringup.md step 5.6 to match (DEF-21)

title: BU-5.7 U3's EN at a live plug-in
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.7 (scope TP6 PWR_EN and TP2, cell in, board off)
pass_limit: PWR_EN <= 5.5 V at every instant (the RT9013's EN, 6 V absolute), 10 plug-ins

title: BU-6 power switch: on, latch, off, reset
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 6 (bringup.md 6.2-6.3 still say Y: DEF-21)
pass_limit: on only after Start held 1.0 +-0.2 s; off after a long press; RESET turns it off on the cell; off current back <= 30 uA

title: First power with JP1 cut (catch a wrong LDO before it reaches the chip)
procedure: add to bringup.md step 1: unit 1 with JP1 cut, USB through a 100 mA limit, DMM on 3V3_LDO; then bridge JP1
pass_limit: 3V3_LDO 3.20-3.40 V before JP1 is bridged

title: Chip identity and stepping, logged per unit
procedure: picotool info -a (chip ID, package, stepping, flash JEDEC ID) at first boot; write it to the unit's record
pass_limit: RP2354B, 2 MB flash; stepping recorded (A2 means E9 applies to AMP_EN and BL_PWM)

title: Production self-test image
procedure: write a self-test UF2 on the generated pin file (VER-149): buttons; a GPIO neighbour-bridge test whose pair table is generated from design.GPIO_PIN, marking each pin safe to toggle or not (PWR_HOLD, CHG_OFF, AMP_EN, BL_PWM, the QSPI pins), using the external pull's direction where one exists, on USB power only, and cross-checked against hardware/vv/bridges.csv (VER-148); panel ID and fills; backlight; audio tone; ADC; charger states incl. the 2 Hz fault; the 16-bit shift-register read; no OTP or flash-security writes
pass_limit: every item PASS on a good unit and FAIL on a seeded fault (a shorted button, a panel unplugged); every 'caught by self-test' pair in bridges.csv is in its pair table; <= 5 min a unit

title: PWR_HOLD release after reset and crash on the real board
procedure: scope PWR_HOLD at U4 pin 55 (GPIO44; it has no pad: probe D2 pin 2 or R42), TP6 (PWR_EN) and TP4 (+3V3) through RESET, a watchdog reset and a hard fault, on the cell
pass_limit: PWR_HOLD < 0.5 V within 10 ms; 3V3 < 0.5 V within 200 ms of Start released

title: Start with 1 kohm in series still turns the device on (both Start domes)
procedure: 1 kohm in series with each Start dome in turn (SW21, then SW23: across its pads in place of a press); bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V
pass_limit: for each dome: 3V3 >= 3.20 V within 50 ms; PWR_BTN_N (SW21) or P2_START (SW23) reads low; Q1's or Q7's gate margin over its maximum Vgs(th) (q1.json) reported in volts

title: Start leakage immunity and per-unit dome leakage (both Start domes)
procedure: 1 Mohm across SW21's pads, then across SW23's, cell at 4.2 V, no USB; then each unit's leakage from the VSYS ring to the centre pad of both domes as VER-46
pass_limit: the device stays off (3V3 < 0.5 V) for 10 min with either; every unit's SW21 and SW23 >= 100 Mohm

title: USB sources, cables and orientations
procedure: both plug orientations on a USB-C charger, a PD charger, an A-to-C cable from a PC and from a hub, the bench supply at a 500 mA limit; 5 cables. Characterisation (recorded, not pass/fail: REQ-PWR-01, REQ-PWR-16): bench supply into VBUS through a USB-C breakout at 4.40 V and 4.60 V, backlight full, DMM across cut JP5 at CV: U2's VIN-DPM (4.5 V): the input current it takes and whether the cell supplements the system
pass_limit: charges and enumerates in both orientations on every source; no limit cycling at 500 mA; every cable seats fully, case closed
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d) and a PD charger (owned?)

title: Input current from a default-power USB port
procedure: USB power meter between a PC's USB-A port and the device, charging a flat cell with the backlight at 100%
pass_limit: input current <= 500 mA within 2 s of plug-in from a default-power port (U2's USB500 limit, 475 mA), the backlight at full and a flat cell charging

title: Charge path after charge-done plus 1 h (unit 1 confirmation)
procedure: unit 1, after VER-133 and VER-169 pass: a real cell charged to done with USB in, then 1 h more; DMM on TP3; DMM across cut JP5 for 1 min at the end
pass_limit: VBAT <= 4.242 V after 1 h at charge-done; the cell current 0 to -5 mA (U2 off the cell until VBAT falls 100 mV, then a top-up)

title: 3V3 regulation and 3V3 load
procedure: bench supply into VBUS (USB-C breakout) and as the cell 3.6-4.2 V; DMM on mA across cut JP1 at idle and at the self-test's heaviest load
pass_limit: 3V3 3.20-3.40 V at every point; 3V3 load <= 150 mA

title: 1V1 core rail level and ripple
procedure: scope on TP9 (1V1), 20 MHz limit, ground spring, at idle and at full CPU load
pass_limit: within the RP2350's DVDD range (Table 1688: write the values into this row on first use) including ripple

title: Cell surface temperature over a full charge in the closed case
procedure: attended, in a LiPo bag on a tile (VER-172); K-type thermocouple taped to the cell (a DMM with a thermocouple input, about $25 if not owned); log every minute; 25 C room, then a 35 C box
pass_limit: <= 45 C at 25 C ambient; <= the cell maker's charge maximum at 35 C
needs: DMM with thermocouple input (about $25, 2d)

title: Touch temperature during charge-while-playing
procedure: the firmware rule from VER-144 in the image first; thermocouples on the face over U2, the back over U7 and the hottest spot found by touch; 1 h charge-while-playing, backlight 100%, audio full scale
pass_limit: <= 43 C (target) at 25 C ambient; measured rise + the rated maximum ambient <= 48 C (IEC 62368-1 TS1 limit for plastic held 10 min to 8 h)

title: TH1 tracks the cell during charge
procedure: two thermocouples: one at the cell's centre and one on its end facing TH1; TH1 from the TS voltage (VER-68); one full charge in the closed case
pass_limit: TH1 within 5 C of the cell's hotter point throughout
needs: a second thermocouple (about $3, 7d)

title: Cell protection (PCM) trip test on a spare pack
procedure: bench supply into the pack: raise to find OVP, discharge through a resistor to find UVP, short through 0.1 ohm for OCP
pass_limit: OVP 4.25-4.35 V; UVP 2.4-3.0 V; OCP trips (or the spec sheet's values) on one pack per lot

title: Assembled-board inspection under the microscope (IPC-A-610 Class 2)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 3.2 extended: U4's QFN-80 edges; U2's VQFN-16 with BAT pins 2 and 3 against the exposed pad (DF-148) and the ISET 16 / TS 1 corner (DF-146); J3's FH12-50 at 0.5 mm pitch; U8 and U9 (TSSOP-16); the SOIC-8s (U6, U7); the SOT-23, SOT-23-5 and SOT-23-6 leads; the SOD-323s; the 0402s and the 4 x 0402 arrays RN1-RN4; J1's pin row; J2, J4 (PicoBlade) and J5; the bare SW20-SW23 dome pads and their vents; every pin 1 against the silk; the 1.0 mm FR4 rim between the speaker's hole and the board's right edge, uncracked (DF-178)
pass_limit: no bridge, tombstone, lifted lead or missing part; every pin 1 as the silk; every unit

title: Board flatness on arrival
procedure: board on a glass plate, feeler gauges (about $5) at the corners
pass_limit: bow and twist <= 0.75% of the board's length: 1.14 mm over 151.64 mm (case.scad board_l; the Edge.Cuts outline)

title: Hand assembly demo and time study
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md sections 3-5 on one unit, timed, ESD mat and strap (about $15); no iron: nothing is soldered at assembly; record the step order: J3 latched, the cell into the tub's pocket, J2 then J4 plugged; on opening, J2 unplugged before the tub lifts away (DF-169, DF-170, DEF-41)
pass_limit: one unit in <= 30 min with a screwdriver and a knife; no part damaged; no connector mated or unmated with the tub lifting the cell's leads; the cell plug never offered to J4; cell and panel each swap in <= 10 min
needs: ESD mat and strap (about $15, 2d)

title: Case open/close cycling
procedure: 20 open/close cycles with the six screws at the length VER-147 sets, as assembly.md step 8; the case closed with the cell unplugged; after the cycles: C53 (the MLCC nearest a boss) at 40x and TP4 to GND re-measured
pass_limit: no cracked key or grip rib and no stripped boss; the top still seats; C53 (the MLCC nearest a boss, 11.4 mm from H5) uncracked and TP4 > 1 kohm; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Drop test
procedure: unit 4 (sacrificial, gates.md allocation): 3 drops from 1.0 m onto hardwood on the face, an end and a corner (IEC 62368-1 Annex T.7, to confirm); re-run on the DVT spin when a change record asks
pass_limit: still works; no crack that exposes the cell or a board; cell moved <= 1 mm; plug and FPC still seated

title: Button life cycling
procedure: unit 4 or a bare board in a printed case: a hobby servo and a Pico press one button of each type (about $10 of parts)
pass_limit: 100,000 presses with contact resistance staying < 1 kohm
needs: hobby servo and a Pico (about $10, 7d)

title: ESD screen on unit 4 (piezo igniter)
procedure: unit 4: a piezo lighter igniter (about $3, uncalibrated, about 10 kV) at each cap gap (comb pads first), the seams and the USB-C shell, 10 zaps each; the calibrated test is VER-170 on the DVT spin
pass_limit: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle; any dead input or latch-up named for the DVT fix (0402 series-resistor footprints on the button nets and SW21)
needs: piezo lighter igniter (about $3, 2d)

title: Near-field emissions pre-scan
procedure: unit 4 or 2: H-field probe set (about $25, or a loop of coax) on the scope's FFT over the board, case open and closed
pass_limit: the five largest peaks named with their source; none from a net that should be quiet
needs: H-field probe set (about $25, 7d)

title: Margins and abuse on a sacrificial board
procedure: unit 4 (sacrificial): VBUS 4.0-6.0 V; cell emulation 2.8-4.3 V; 0-45 C by fridge and warm box; shorted speaker; panel unplugged hot; reversed cell through a 0.5 A limit
pass_limit: no damage inside the rated range; outside it, failure is safe (no heat above 60 C, no smoke)

title: DFMEA review
procedure: Alex and two independent models read dfmea.csv; every S >= 9 row lists its layers of protection
pass_limit: every row reviewed; every H row has an action, a passing detection or an acceptance; reviewers named
needs: two independent reviewers (0d)

title: USB VBUS capacitance and inrush
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py inrush: the capacitance on VBUS from design.py, and which parts join VBUS to VSYS (only U2, whose input switch brings VSYS up inside its input limit)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: VBUS capacitance <= 10 uF (USB 2.0 cl. 7.2.4.1; C1 10 uF: 50 uC at 5.0 V) and U2 (a BQ2407x) the only part between VBUS and VSYS

title: Audio chain simulation (filter, coupling, FM8002A input)
procedure: not in the repo: the ngspice filter run quoted in validation_plan #40/#153; commit it under board/sim/
pass_limit: -3 dB >= 10 kHz; low corner <= 50 Hz; carrier at 586 kHz >= 40 dB down

title: Play time from full to cutoff
procedure: self-test image's soak mode: 50% backlight, a tune at -12 dBFS; log VBAT over USB CDC or RTT every minute
pass_limit: >= 4 h from charge-done to the 3.50 V cutoff at 25 C

title: Charge time from cutoff to done
procedure: from the 3.50 V cutoff, charger only (backlight off); log CHG pins and time
pass_limit: <= 4.0 h to CHG_STAT_N high (charge done) at 25 C from a source offering >= 0.5 A at 4.75-5.25 V (REQ-PRD-04.R)

title: Shelf and deep-discharge estimate
procedure: re-derive the off-state budget for the BQ24073 board first (design_review.md's Off state, 18-22 uA, still counts D5's reverse leakage, which left in 2d1124d): the 940k divider, U2 from BAT, U7 in shutdown on the live VSYS, U3 off; then a spreadsheet: off current (VER-65, and at 45 C from VER-146) plus the PCM's own drain (3-6 uA, which never passes JP5: from VER-37) plus the cell's self-discharge (1-3% a month) against the capacity between the cutoff and the PCM's UVP (VER-153)
pass_limit: >= 2 months from the cutoff to the PCM's UVP at 25 C and at 45 C storage; >= 2 years from full (or the numbers Alex sets knowing both terms)

title: Watchdog rule written down
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/pinmap.md, Power control
pass_limit: the rule 'enable the watchdog before any blocking init' is written in the pin map
evidence: hardware/ref_design/docs/pinmap.md (Power control: 'Enable the watchdog before any blocking init')

title: Hang test on the self-test image
procedure: a self-test command that hangs with PWR_HOLD high, on the cell
pass_limit: the device is off within 10 s (watchdog reset releases PWR_HOLD)

title: Panel FPC fold and ZIF retention
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md step 4; then the display test after 10 case closures
pass_limit: FPC fully in, square, latch shut; 0.5-3 mm slack; display test passes after 10 closures

title: Recovery through the pinholes, case closed
procedure: case closed: BOOTSEL + RESET through the pinholes with a 1 mm pin enters the USB boot loader; repeat with a flat cell on USB
pass_limit: boot loader drive appears both times

title: USB D+/D- stub and pair length
procedure: write board/tools/check_usb.py (pcbnew)
pass_limit: stubs <= 3.5 mm (pin_review/j1.json); D+/D- length mismatch <= 2 mm

title: First article inspection (AS9102 style) per lot
procedure: fill the sheet fai_sheet.py writes (VER-166) on unit 1: every BOM line present, marking (U2 reads BQ24073, not a '72 or '74: DF-144), orientation (J3's pin-1 end, U4's dot), key dimensions, the cell leads' sleeving where they pass the board's hole
pass_limit: every characteristic recorded and within limits before the rest of the lot is powered; the checker accepts the sheet

title: Per-unit production record with serial
procedure: serial on the board's back; hardware/vv/evidence/units.csv (one row a unit: release, chip ID and stepping, cell lot, VBAT gain, mating counts for J2, J3, J4, J5, allocation, self-test log, golden flags) and hardware/vv/evidence/findings.csv (one row a finding: serial, finding, found by FAI, bring-up or self-test, disposition rework, scrap or use as is, re-test done)
pass_limit: every unit has a complete row; every reworked unit re-tested; any finding on 2 units raised as a DEF with a check

title: First-pass yield record
procedure: count of units passing VER-76 first time; a DEF entry per failure
pass_limit: >= 90% first-pass yield; every failure explained

title: Part heights from drawings, not guesses (check_fit truth)
procedure: fill check_fit's KNOWN_HEIGHT from each MPN's drawing; make an unknown package a failure, not a 1.5 mm default; at CASE, with the drawings in hand
pass_limit: every part's height cited; 0 parts on PACKAGE_HEIGHT guesses
needs: each MPN's drawing (the panel's, the cell's, the parts'), 7d

title: No unintended openings through the top or the tub
procedure: write case/check_openings.py: compare the printed parts' through-holes with the intended list (another branch has check_manifold.py)
pass_limit: 0 through-openings other than the listed ones

title: Every drilled hole >= 0.30 mm
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py holes: every via, plated and unplated hole on battler.kicad_pcb (pcbnew)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: the smallest hole is 0.30 mm or more

title: Test-point coverage for every bring-up measurement
procedure: cross-reference every quantity in bringup.md with TP1-TP16, jumper pads and named part pads
pass_limit: every bring-up measurement names a TP, a jumper pad or a named part pad (TP7 is the TS node, CHG_TEMP); 0 that need a lifted part
evidence: folded into VER-158 on 2026-10-26 (round 2's proportionality objection): the probes table and its script are the same cross-reference, run on every change

title: Bench gear matrix
procedure: list each check's gear and parts in the 'needs' column; python3 hardware/vv/tools/check_trace.py --shopping prints them by lead time; include the 4.096 V reference (F-38), clip leads (F-52), a LiPo bag (F-43), two thermocouples (DF-04), the piezo igniter, a USB-C breakout, PicoBlade saver pigtails
pass_limit: every T/I check runs on owned or listed gear; buys with a lead time placed before the boards arrive

title: Cost re-quote after the latest changes
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/cost.py; JLC and PCBWay instant quotes (hardware/ref_design/tools/quotes)
pass_limit: <= $45 a unit at 10, all in

title: Emissions at a test house
procedure: FCC Part 15 Class B / CISPR 32 Class B radiated and conducted
pass_limit: pass with >= 3 dB margin

title: prod_board: contacts where prod_case says
procedure: write a checker beside place_buttons.py: each SW footprint against layout.scad's echo block
pass_limit: every contact within 0.05 mm of its layout.scad position

title: BOM, CPL and PCB fields against design.py (check_bom_cpl.py)
procedure: write board/tools/check_bom_cpl.py, run inside fab.py before zipping and in scripts/check.sh: (1) design.PARTS against battler.kicad_pcb's footprints (Reference, Value, LCSC, footprint id, layer); (2) battler_bom_jlc.csv and battler_cpl_jlc.csv against design.PARTS: every bom=True ref exactly once, LCSC present, top side only, no ref that design.PARTS marks bom False or dnp and no build_pcb.NO_ASSEMBLY ref (both sets read from the files, never typed); (3) totals against assembly.md
pass_limit: 0 differences; the BOM's line count and the CPL's placement count equal those derived from design.PARTS (44 lines and 118 placements at be437f8, from fab.py's bom_cpl()) and assembly.md's, which must agree; exit 1 otherwise

title: Drill files: PTH and NPTH apart, holes as designed
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py drill: imports board/tools/fab.py, points its OUT at a temp dir, runs its own gerbers() export (kicad-cli) and parses every .drl it writes; compares each hole and slot with the board's pads and vias (pcbnew). A word in fab.py cannot pass it (seeded in VER-129)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: no MixedPlating file; every unplated hole (J1's pegs, SW20-SW23's vents, H1-H6) in a NonPlated file and every plated hole, via and slot in a Plated one, each at its pcbnew position; plated slots at least JLC's 0.50 mm (fails today: one MixedPlating file)

title: Fab file content (check_fab_content.py, reusing membrane/tools/gerb.py)
procedure: write check_fab_content.py over the files fab.py's gerbers() and bom_cpl() write into a temp dir (as design_numbers.py drill does): (a) every Excellon tool >= 0.30 mm; (b) no F.Paste aperture and no silk inside any comb's 4.8 mm circle, F.Mask opening >= 4.8 mm at each of the 20 contact centres, and no via or pour within 2.9 mm of a contact's centre but its own stubs (was VER-25); (c) copper under every CPL centroid on F.Cu; (d) BOM and CPL counts as VER-130; (e) no copper within 0.30 mm of Edge.Cuts except J1's pads; (f) B.Paste empty: nothing is assembled on the back; (g) all 9 layers, both drill files and the job file present, Edge.Cuts closed with the cell's and the speaker's holes; every silk text on the board (as VER-18); (h) no aux_axis_origin in the pcb (or one origin flag for all three exports) and every Excellon hole on a pad or via centre in the copper; (i) the drill files as VER-131 (J1's four 0.60 mm plated slots, the 0.5 mm vents); (j) the CPL as VER-176; (k) the 'JLCJLCJLCJLC' order-number marker on B.Silkscreen (REQ-FAB-05; absent at be437f8), or the release record names JLC's paid removal option; the sha256 of battler_gerbers.zip, the BOM and the CPL into the release record (board/fab is gitignored)
pass_limit: 0 violations on every item; exit 1 otherwise; output saved as evidence

title: Per-unit charge-path screen with USB in and no cell
procedure: bringup.md step 1 (to be added) and the production test, before any cell touches the unit: USB from the bench supply at 5.0 V with a 100 mA limit through a USB-C breakout; DMM on TP1 (VBUS), TP2 (VSYS), TP3 (VBAT), TP7 (TS); scope on TP3 for 10 s (U2's battery detection toggles BAT with no cell); clip leads only (DF-114)
pass_limit: TP2 4.30-4.50 V; TP3 peak <= 4.25 V on the scope; TP7 within design_numbers.py tsband's band at the ambient read beside the board; CHG_PG_N low; every unit
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d) and a clip-lead set (about $8, 2d)

title: Per-unit CV with a load in place of the cell
procedure: a PicoBlade pigtail (on the saver, VER-157) across J2 carrying the CV load: 160 ohm 0.25 W 1% in parallel with a TL431 (TO-92, cathode to anode set to 3.5 V by 10k over 24.9k 1%) in series with 22 ohm 0.25 W 1%; USB in; read TP3 within 60 s. No resistor alone can do it: design_numbers.py cvload computes from SLUS810N (KPRECHG 70-106 A-ohm, ITERM 0.09-0.11 x ICHG) that a resistor must exceed 147.6 ohm to leave pre-charge and stay under 126.7 ohm never to terminate (O-R2). With the TL431 branch the load sits at 3.31 V or more at the smallest pre-charge current (21.0 mA, the branch off) and draws 52 mA or more at 4.16 V (over the largest termination current, 32.8 mA), at every corner cvload checks. Not a 3.3 V zener (too soft) and not three diodes (they conduct at about 2 V)
pass_limit: TP3 4.158-4.242 V; CHG_STAT_N low (still in CV, not terminated); every unit
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference that session
needs: 160 ohm and 22 ohm 0.25 W 1% resistors, a TL431 in TO-92, 10k and 24.9k 1% resistors and a PicoBlade pigtail pair (about $3, LCSC, 7d)

title: Per-unit TS window: TH1 is an NTC and the hot pause works
procedure: USB in, the VER-134 load fitted: read TP7 (TS); hold a finger on TH1 for 20 s and read it again; then clip 4.7 kohm across TH1 (10k || 4.7k = 3.2k: TS 0.24 V, under the 0.30 V hot threshold), then remove it
pass_limit: TS within design_numbers.py tsband's band before; at least 0.03 V lower after the finger (an NTC, not a fixed 10k: DF-146); with 4.7k: CHG_STAT_N high within 2 s (paused); removed: CHG_STAT_N low again within 2 s; every unit
needs: 4.7k resistors and a clip-lead set (about $8, 2d)

title: J3 map and the FPC fold with the real panel, unpowered
procedure: a loose FH12-50S breakout on the fit-kit board mock in J3's position and orientation; insert the FPC as assembly.md section 5 step 6 (panel face down, contacts down), fold the panel over; bench supply at 3.3 V with a 5 mA current limit through 330 ohm (about 2 mA), DMM in volts across breakout pins 50 (+) and 49 and 48; then the reverse step with the DMM on its diode range and no supply
pass_limit: forward step: 2.4-3.0 V across pins 50 and 49 and across pins 50 and 48, with a faint glow (F-R6); reverse step: the DMM's diode range reads OL; pins 1, 2, 3 and 8 joined (panel GND pins 50, 49, 48, 43)
instrument: bench supply (3.3 V, 5 mA current limit) and a handheld DMM (volts and diode ranges)
accuracy: +-0.02 V on the forward step (a handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts); OL is the reverse reading
needs: FH12-50S breakout (about $5, 7d), a 330 ohm resistor and the panel (VER-43)

title: Backlight worst-case current and the halves at the minimum duty
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py backlight: from design.py's R52, R53, R60, R61 with 3V3 +2% (RT9013), 1% resistors and U6's 4.5 mV offset; the firmware's highest and lowest duty read from pinmap.md's Backlight section (100% while it names no cap); it prints the duty cap and the R61 that would pass
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: <= 120 mA in all at worst case at the firmware's highest duty (the ER-TFT035IPS-6's 120 mA); each sink within +-25% of nominal at the firmware's minimum duty (18%, pinmap.md) (fails at be437f8: 122.4 mA at 100%; a cap at 97.9% or R61 3.74k passes: DEC-31)

title: Cutoff accuracy analysis: the calibrated reading against the true cell voltage
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py cutoff: the reading pinmap.md's calibration gives (gain at charge-done, CV 4.2 V +-1%) against the true cell voltage, with 3V3 +-2%, the RT9013's dropout scaled to 150 mA (pin_review/u3.json) and GPIO47's pad leakage through R17/R18's 235 kohm (the RP2350's IIN maximum of 1 uA, rp2350.txt:101199, quoted by VER-34)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: the cutoff acts at a true 3.50 V +0.05/-0.00 V at every corner, pad leakage included; a corner whose lowest reading in dropout stays above 3.50 V (the cutoff never fires) fails (at be437f8 the worst corner's lowest reading in dropout is 3.521 V, so the cutoff never fires there; the pad leakage, 0.47 V of VBAT per uA, is the second failure)

title: Cutoff bench sweep without USB
procedure: no USB; bench supply into J2 through the saver (it only sources here), 3.7 V down to 3.0 V in 20 mV steps; self-test at full CPU and panel load; firmware VBAT over USB CDC or RTT against a DMM on TP3; on the unit with the highest TP4 (3V3) reading; at 25 C, then the 3.50 V point again with the unit warmed to about 40 C (a closed box and a lamp, the DMM's thermocouple on U1), to measure the drift the pad leakage gives (DEC-07, O-R6)
pass_limit: at 25 C the firmware shuts down at a true 3.50-3.55 V and its reading falls at every step down to the cutoff; the reading's drift from 25 C to 40 C at 3.50 V is recorded (more than 50 mV of VBAT moves DEC-07's divider change to DVT)
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference
needs: a DMM with a thermocouple input (owned or $25, 7d)

title: Cell mating peak against the PCM's short-circuit trip
procedure: from design.py: with no USB, plugging the cell charges C3 at once and, through U2's battery FET (on with no input), C2, C5, C34 and C35 (through JP3): about 35 uF; series path (cell ESR, PCM FETs, leads, the FET) 0.15-0.35 ohm; compare the peak with the PCM's short-circuit threshold and delay (VER-37) and J2's rating; and the VSYS edge through Q1, D2, Q7, D8 and R13-R15 into PWR_EN
pass_limit: peak below the PCM's short-circuit trip at its delay, or the lockout's recovery written into assembly.md; PWR_EN stays below U3's 0.6 V EN low level through the edge
needs: the cell's PCM data (VER-37), 7d

title: Cell mating on unit 1: 10 plug-ins on the scope
procedure: no USB; scope on TP2 (VSYS) and TP6 (PWR_EN); plug a 4.2 V cell into J2 through the saver 10 times
pass_limit: VBAT present after every plug (no PCM lockout); PWR_EN stays low (the device stays off); VSYS peak <= 4.5 V

title: MLCC keep-out from the case's screw bosses

pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: every MLCC pad centre 4.0 mm or more from a screw hole's centre (boss radius + 1), and 6.0 mm or more for an 0603 or larger

title: Release run from a clean, tagged worktree (release.py)
procedure: write hardware/vv/tools/release.py: refuse a dirty tree, and refuse to build fab files when any DESIGN_PATHS blob differs from README's design baseline; at the tagged commit rebuild the board from design.py (route.py), re-run the DRC and diff the rebuilt copper against the committed battler.kicad_pcb with the dated lines stripped (62b01f2 moved a GND via by hand: O-R10, DEF-60), then run fab.py --no-pictures twice and compare the gerbers and drill files with TF.CreationDate and the Excellon date header stripped (was VER-24), check_bom_cpl, check_fab_content, the drill check and every scripted check; write evidence with the zip's, BOM's and CPL's sha256, case/positions.json's sha256 (gitignored, so not in the baseline) and the KiCad, OpenSCAD and Python versions; fill the EVT release record
pass_limit: exits 0 at a clean tag; the record's sha256 equals the uploaded zip's; every scripted check's evidence names that commit; the two runs' copper and drill files identical once dated lines are stripped; the rebuilt board's copper equals the committed file's once dated lines are stripped (no hand edit survives a rebuild)

title: Dissipation per mode with positions; the firmware heat rule
procedure: a table per mode (off, cell play, USB play, charging, charging while playing) of each part's dissipation and position: U2 up to about 0.66 W ((5.0 - 4.4) V x 475 mA + (4.4 - 3.0) V x 270 mA), U7 up to about 0.4 W, Q5/Q6 about 0.1 W together, U3 about 0.17 W; U2's junction through its pad; from it a firmware rule written in pinmap.md (for example CHG_OFF or capped volume while the backlight is at full on USB)
pass_limit: the table written with each mode's total; U2's junction under its thermal regulation point in a 40 C case; the firmware rule in pinmap.md before VER-86 runs

title: The charger's safety timer and its fault on screen
procedure: unit 1, no cell: the load of VER-134 in the cell's place (160 ohm in parallel with the TL431 branch) keeps U2 in CV, so it never terminates; leave USB in for 6.5 h (SLUS810N's tMAXCHG with TMR open is 4-6 h, bq24074.txt:818, and it runs slower while DPPM or thermal regulation cuts the current); then the self-test reads CHG_STAT_N
pass_limit: CHG_STAT_N at 2 Hz by 6 h from the start (U2's fast-charge timer, TMR open: 4-6 h) and the time it started flashing recorded; the firmware shows a charge fault until USB is re-plugged
needs: the VER-134 load parts (about $3, LCSC, 7d)

title: Off-state current at 45 C (warm box)
procedure: unit 2: an insulated box, a bulb and a thermometer at 45 C and 60 C, cell in, no USB, device off, DMM across cut JP5
pass_limit: at 45 C the JP5 current within REQ-PWR-07's 45 C limit (60 uA); at 60 C PWR_EN low and the device off
needs: a warm box from household parts, 0d

title: Screw engagement in the case's pilots

pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: the side screws (H1-H4) 4.0 mm or more of thread above the board, their tip 0.5 mm or more short of the pilot's end; the end screws (H5, H6) 3.0 mm or more and 0.1 mm short (REQ-MEC-09; fails today: M2 x 6 gives the side screws 3.2 mm; M2 x 7 there passes)

pass_limit: exit 1 on any pair bridges.csv does not list (about 107 net pairs today); every dangerous pair names a live DF row (U2 BAT 2/3 to EP: DF-148; ISET 16 to TS 1: DF-146)

pass_limit: 0 differences; 0 literal pin numbers in board_ref code (today fw-ref-board a01f6fb reads the charger on PIN_41/42 and drives PIN_28-30 as a 74HC165: origin/main's map, DEF-34)

title: A minimal REF-A self-test builds for the ordered chip
procedure: add a board_ref_a feature with embassy-rp/rp235xb and memory-ref-a.x (FLASH LENGTH = 2048K); cargo build --no-default-features --features rp235xb,board_ref_a of a stub (RTT hello, the shift-register button scan, PWR_HOLD) in scripts/check.sh; save the llvm-size output
pass_limit: builds and links for rp235xb at 2048K; size recorded

title: The game image fits the RP2354B's 2 MB (the llvm-size figure)
procedure: llvm-size on the release build of the full game (both engines and the sprite blob) for the RP2350, on the present firmware target until VER-150's board_ref_a build exists (the code's size does not depend on the package); the flash map and the check.sh step are VER-185's (EVT)
pass_limit: image <= the limit Alex sets (proposed 1.6 MB of 2 MB)

title: ESTIMATE ledger: case numbers that set copper are measured
procedure: write case/check_estimates.py: list every ESTIMATE variable in case.scad and follow it into the positions.json keys it changes; each copper-affecting one needs a measured value and an evidence file (calipers on the real cell plug, the panel's FPC, the DS Lite Start/Select membrane); the panel's numbers are read first off the drawing on disk (er-tft035ips-6.txt:175, :209-218, :239, :263-285: 54.56 x 82.84 +-0.2, 2.1 to 2.15 +-0.15, the neck 30.58 - 26.11, the 25.5 mm tail) and then on the real panel
pass_limit: 0 copper-affecting ESTIMATEs without a measurement: at be437f8 the panel's outline, active area, thickness and FPC neck, body, tail and tip range (the old 3.5 in design's numbers; the drawing, ER-TFT035IPS-6 REV 1.0 of Dec-15-2022 with its outline drawn Dec-20-22, is on disk in the main checkout and differs from case.scad: DEF-59), fpc_slack, the cell's 52 x 36 x 4.5, plug_xs, ss_pitch and ss_mem among them; assembly.md's cell-hole size agrees with Edge.Cuts
needs: calipers (2d), cells (21d), the panel (10d), the DS Lite pad kit (owned)

title: Usable cell capacity per lot
procedure: one cell per lot: charge from the bench supply at 4.20 V with a 0.35 A limit (a CC/CV charger) until the current falls to 36 mA; discharge at about 140 mA through 27 ohm 2 W (or a ZB2L3-style tester), logging the voltage every minute
pass_limit: mAh to 3.50 V and to 3.60 V recorded; >= 600 mAh to the chosen cutoff (a proposal: Alex sets the lot limit); REQ-PRD-03.R recomputed from it
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d) and a 27 ohm 2 W resistor or a ZB2L3 tester (about $8, 14d)

title: Panel bond under press and heat
procedure: an EVT unit in its case: 20 N (kitchen scale) at the glass centre 100 times, then 24 h at 50 C in the warm box (VER-146)
pass_limit: the panel still bonded; no mura; no new contact marks on the panel's back; the tape's part number in the release record
needs: a kitchen scale (owned?), 0d

title: VBAT gain calibration per unit at 3.50 V
procedure: production test: no USB, the bench supply into J2 at 3.50 V, the self-test at its highest 3V3 load; a DMM checked that session against the 4.096 V reference; the firmware stores true / reading; record the raw ADC count, the DMM value and the gain in evidence/unit-<serial>.csv
pass_limit: gain within 0.95-1.05; a re-read at 3.50 V within 10 mV (as VBAT); the expected count computed from design.py's R17 and R18 at the released values
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference
needs: 4.096 V reference breakout (about $3, 7d)

title: No VBAT gain stored from a no-cell end-of-charge edge
procedure: the self-test on USB with no cell for 5 min (U2's battery detection toggles CHG_STAT_N)
pass_limit: no gain written; the stored production gain unchanged

title: Connector mating count per unit
procedure: count every mating of J2, J3, J4 and J5 in units.csv; bench pigtails through one PicoBlade saver that stays plugged; each rating confirmed in its maker's spec and written into j2.json, j3.json and j4.json
pass_limit: no shipped unit past half its rated cycles on any connector; no unit used for FAI or abuse ships
needs: a spare PicoBlade pigtail pair for the saver (about $2, 7d)

title: Test access for every per-unit screen (check_test_access.py)
procedure: a probes table in bringup.md covering every quantity it measures (was VER-115) (the refs each step probes: TP1-TP16, JP1-JP5, J2, J4, J5, J7, with the net each must sit on); write check_test_access.py, which imports design.py
pass_limit: exit 1 when a listed ref is missing, is no longer DNP or a test pad, or sits on another net than the table names

title: Back-power path table (check_backpower.py)
procedure: write board/tools/check_backpower.py over design.nets(): give each part a 'powered by' rail (U4, U6 and the panel on +3V3; U2 on VBUS and VBAT; U7 on AMP_VDD); flag every net that joins an I/O of a +3V3 part to a source live when 3V3 is off (VBUS, VSYS, VBAT, CC1/CC2, USB_DP/DM, SWD, the panel SPI with JP4 cut); each flagged path needs an entry with its worst-case current; seed DEF-01 by moving U1 pin 5 to VBUS; at ORDER Alex reads by hand the four paths the script names (F-R2(c))
pass_limit: exit 1 on an unlisted path; today it flags R17/R18 (VBAT/2 into GPIO47), R3/R4 (CC into GPIO45/46 for about 1 ms at plug-in), R9/R10 (3V3 pull-ups on CHG_PG_N and CHG_STAT_N, U2 pins 7 and 9, with VBUS at 0) and U1's REF; the seeded DEF-01 fails

title: Charge current and window tied to the cell (cell.json)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/board/cell.json (model, capacity, standard charge current, charge temperature range, PCM values) filled from VER-37; case.scad's cell numbers and a power-analysis script read it and assert
pass_limit: 890 V / R5 (the BQ24073's KISET) <= min(0.5 C, the standard charge current); the TS window (VER-32) inside the cell's charge range; case.scad's cell size equals cell.json's
needs: the spec sheet (VER-37), 7d

title: Docs and the register quote the design's values (check_claims.py)
procedure: write tools/check_claims.py: extract '<ref> <value>' pairs (R21 27 ohm, R42 4.7k, R5 3.3k), 'GPIO<n> (<net>)' and 'GPIO<n> <net>', 'U<n> pin <n>', 'TP<n> (<net>)' and the board and case dimensions (from case.scad's JSON echo); scope hardware/vv/*.csv and *.md, ref_design/docs/*.md, ref_design/README.md and ref_design/board/pin_review/*.json, skipping RETIRED rows and 'Was:' text; compare with design.PARTS, design.GPIO and the case echo; run in check_trace's default mode, so the next design commit fails it until the rows are re-checked; one seeded fault (a GPIO changed in a scratch clone, rebaselined) must fail the default mode
pass_limit: exit 1 on any mismatch; today it must find DEF-21 (b), (d), (e), (j), part of (k), and u4.json's E9 note (PWR_HOLD 'GPIO2', BL_PWM 'GPIO44')
covers: hardware/ref_design/board/design.py hardware/ref_design/case/case.scad hardware/ref_design/docs/*.md hardware/ref_design/board/pin_review/*.json hardware/vv/requirements.md hardware/vv/dfmea.csv hardware/vv/verification.csv

title: Contact footprints as placed on battler.kicad_pcb
procedure: extract each SW footprint embedded in battler.kicad_pcb to a scratch .kicad_mod and run check_contact_fp.py on it (4ring with the 3.5 mm pill; Dome_4mm_Round against VER-178's rule)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS for SW1-SW16 as placed (copper gap >= 0.20 mm, bridging spot <= 1.60 mm, mask covers the comb) and SW20-SW23 against VER-178's dome rule

title: Contact footprints as placed on prod_board.kicad_pcb
procedure: the same as VER-162 over hardware/prod_board/prod_board/prod_board.kicad_pcb, read only
pass_limit: every placed contact passes as VER-10

title: TH1 against the cell's hole; bare copper facing the cell
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py th1: placement.py's cell hole (CUTOUTS) and case.scad's worst-case cell; TH1's position and every flipped footprint's pads read from battler.kicad_pcb (pcbnew), not from placement.py's text
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: TH1 within 1.0 mm of the hole's right edge (where the case pushes the cell) and inside the cell's span along it; no back-side pad within 1 mm of the hole. Geometry only: VER-87 measures the lag

title: Connector mouths and pinholes against the case (check_fit)
procedure: a mouth box per connector from its footprint orientation: J1 (a mated plug), J2 (the plug, 4.3 x 3.3 from plug_xs, plus the wire bend), J3 (the FPC's lead-in), J4 (the speaker's plug and its 35 mm leads), J5 (a JST SH cable, 6 mm); the pinholes against the boss circles; at CASE, with the case in hand
pass_limit: nothing taller than 1 mm inside a mouth box; no box crosses a case wall except its own opening; no pinhole inside a boss circle

title: First-article sheet generated from design.py (fai_sheet.py)
procedure: write tools/fai_sheet.py: one row per BOM line (refs, value, LCSC, expected top marking from pin_review, polarity feature and its silk) plus the key dimensions (the outline read from Edge.Cuts with pcbnew and from case.scad's board_w and board_l, 72.4 x 151.64 mm at be437f8, never typed; 2.2 mm M2 holes, J1's face position, 4.8 mm comb mask) and the unpowered readings of VER-52 and VER-53; a second script refuses an incomplete sheet; sheets saved as evidence/FAI-<serial>.csv
pass_limit: the sheet covers every BOM line; the checker exits 1 on any blank result

title: Every contact class has its bought parts (bom.md)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py bom: for each contact footprint class in design.py (DSL_button_4ring, Dome_4mm_Round) the parts bom.md must name
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: 4-ring: DS Lite silicone and cross and A/B/X/Y caps; domes: the HYP 600-415S-260 dome, Start/Select caps and the Start/Select strip, not 'the Start/Select strip isn't used'

title: Fault injection on the abuse unit (unit 4)
procedure: inject each DFMEA cause whose detection is credited (U2 BAT to its pad, ISET to TS, R5 to GND, TH1 shorted, U8 pins 15-16, a comb shorted, a panel pin bridged) with the bench supply plus 10 ohm 5 W in place of the cell, never a real cell; run the credited detection; save evidence/fault_injection.csv
pass_limit: every credited detection trips; one that does not sends its row's D to 8 or 10 and the row back to H

title: Per-unit cell current with charging off
procedure: after VER-133 passes: a cell at about 3.8 V through the saver, DMM on its A range across cut JP5, USB in, CHG_OFF high from the self-test image; then the uA range
pass_limit: under 1 mA into the cell (U2 off the cell with CE high; read on the uA range once the A range shows nothing); every unit
instrument: handheld DMM, A then uA range

title: ESD to IEC 61000-4-2 on the DVT spin
procedure: a borrowed or rented IEC 61000-4-2 gun: the comb pads first through the cap gaps, then the USB-C shell and the seams
pass_limit: +-4 kV contact and +-8 kV air: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle
needs: an IEC 61000-4-2 gun (borrow from a makerspace or rent), 14d

title: Golden-unit readings
procedure: after unit 1 passes FAI and every analysis limit: record its readings in evidence/golden.csv (TP1-TP7 unpowered resistances, TP3 with no cell, TP1 leakage, input current, TS voltage, backlight current, 3V3); at EVT exit replace them with the median of units 1-4; re-derive at DVT and PVT
pass_limit: the file exists for the phase; a reading outside the band (rail voltages 2%, currents 20%, resistances and leakage beyond 10x or below 0.1x) is a yellow note in units.csv and never changes a verdict or a limit

title: Bench charging rules kept
procedure: each unit's first charge uses the bench supply as the cell (0.5 A limit); a real cell charges only after VER-53, VER-133, VER-169 and VER-135 pass on that unit; every real-cell charge before VER-85 passes is attended, on a tile, in a LiPo bag, thermocouple on the cell, stop rule: above 50 C or any smell, unplug and close the bag
pass_limit: every unit's first real-cell charge recorded with unit, date and preconditions; 0 charges before them
needs: LiPo charging bag (about $8, 2d)

title: Case release record: STL hashes, material, slicer
procedure: fill the case section of the release record: the case.scad commit, sha256 of each exported STL or 3MF, material and brand, printer, slicer profile (layer height, walls, infill, the 100% modifier over J2), the panel tape's part number; emboss the case rev inside the tub
pass_limit: every field filled; VER-48 and VER-92 evidence names the hash

title: XY registration chain, pill to comb and cap to hole
procedure: write case/check_xy.py from case/positions.json and case.scad: every term of the chain (board in tub, the top's button end, silicone, cap) with its tolerance, worst case and RSS
pass_limit: every pill centre within 0.9 mm of its comb centre at worst case

title: CPL position: each footprint's origin against its pads' centre
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py cpl: imports board/tools/fab.py, points its OUT at a temp dir, runs its own bom_cpl(), reads the battler_cpl_jlc.csv it writes and compares every row's Mid X and -Mid Y with that footprint's pad bounding-box centre (pcbnew). A word in fab.py cannot pass it (seeded in VER-129)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: every CPL row within 0.10 mm of its pads' centre, unless the ref has a JLC correction recorded in design_numbers.py's JLC_FIXED with the dry run's screenshot (none today; fails today: J1 1.50 mm, J2 0.95, J4 0.95, J3 0.23)

title: VBUS fault reach: the lowest VBUS that over-stresses a part
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py vbus: from design.py, what VBUS puts on U3's EN through R14/D3/R15, on U2's EN1 through R43 and its internal 285k, on U2's IN and on C1
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: no part over its absolute maximum for VBUS up to 20 V, the highest fixed USB PD voltage a broken source may put out (fails today: U3's EN at 6.9 V); binding at G-EVT-04: DEC-17 is decided before the order through DEF-50 (O-R9)

title: Dome footprint against the 4 mm dome's drawing (Dome_4mm_Round)
procedure: write a check beside check_contact_fp.py: the HYP 600-415S-260 drawing's rim and centre against Dome_4mm_Round.kicad_mod's ring, centre pad, gap and mask (fp_dome.py draws it), and the Kapton dot's size against the pads
pass_limit: the dome's rim lands on the ring all round with 0.2 mm or more to spare at 0.1 mm of placement error; the centre pad under the dimple; 0.20 mm or more copper gap; no paste or silk on the pads
needs: the dome's drawing from the seller, 2d

title: SR_CLK integrity at U9 and a million button reads
procedure: unit 1: scope SR_CLK at U9 pin 2 and U8 pin 2 (10x probe, short ground spring) with the backlight at 100% and audio playing; the self-test reads the chain 1,000,000 times at its clock with every contact released, then with a pattern of pressed contacts held by tape
pass_limit: one monotonic edge per clock at both registers (no step or ring crossing 0.9-2.3 V twice); 0 read errors in 1,000,000 reads in both patterns

title: Start/Select strip's plunger against the dome at rest
procedure: calipers on two Start/Select strips: each plunger's height g under the strip's datum; then ss_lift in case.scad set to 0.35 + max(0, 0.36 - g) as hardware/ref_design/PLAN.md says, and case.scad's two dome asserts re-run
pass_limit: the plunger clears the dome's apex at rest by 0.05 mm or more at the measured g; the dome closes when the cap is pressed through its travel
needs: calipers (about $15, 2d) and two Start/Select strips (AliExpress, 21d)

title: Cell gap on every side: a worst-case cell to the routed FR4 edge, after tolerances
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py cellgap: case.scad's cell_hole, cell_pocket_fit and worst-case and nominal cells, the cell against each wall of the tub's pocket in turn (assembly.md step 5 pushes it right); JLC's routing tolerance, the print's wall tolerance and the board's float on its screws; it prints what would pass (the pocket's fit, the largest cell for this hole, the smallest hole for the worst-case cell)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: >= 0.5 mm from a worst-case cell to the routed FR4 edge on every face it can rest against (both ends and both long sides), 1.5 mm at its lead end, after tolerances (REQ-BAT-08; fails at be437f8 on every side: -0.15 mm at the pushed end and both long sides, 1.35 mm at the lead end)

title: Free height above a worst-case cell (swelling room)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py swell: the free height above a worst-case cell under whatever case.scad puts over the tub's pocket (the panel's back, the panel frame's walls, the ends' underside, the screen band's underside; split from VER-20, O-R21)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: >= 0.4 mm of free height above a worst-case 4.5 mm cell (10% of the nominal 4.0 mm) under everything over its pocket (0.80 mm under the panel's back at be437f8)

title: prod_board: pill resistance and ring leakage on a bare board
procedure: on a bare prod_board from Alex's order: a DS Lite pill pressed on each of SW1-SW16 at 1 N, DMM on ohms; then 4.2 V through each contact's rings into a DMM on volts (10 Mohm input), clean and after a damp-cloth wipe, as VER-45 and VER-46
pass_limit: every contact under 1 kohm pressed; every ring pair >= 100 Mohm (DMM reads <= 0.38 V)
needs: a bare prod_board from Alex's order, 14d

title: J2 and J4 keyed apart: the cell's plug cannot enter the speaker's header
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py plugs: J2's and J4's parts from design.py, their places from battler.kicad_pcb (pcbnew), the speaker's 35 mm leads
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: J4 a part the cell's PicoBlade plug cannot enter (fails at be437f8: J2 and J4 are both the 53261-0271, C177225, 64.2 mm apart on opposite edges)

title: Flash map and the size check in scripts/check.sh
procedure: the flash map (image, settings, battle log) written into the evidence, with the sizes it accounts for; a size check in scripts/check.sh that fails when the image grows past the limit REQ-MCU-10 names; the llvm-size figure itself is VER-151's, at ORDER (F-R2(f))
pass_limit: the flash map written and cited by the size check; scripts/check.sh fails on a release build over the limit

title: LCSC identity script over the JLC parts database
procedure: write board/tools/check_lcsc.py: read the JLC parts database and compare every line of design.py's BOM with the LCSC record (MPN, package, pin count, rating, stock class); the by-hand pass at ORDER is VER-14's
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences between design.py and the LCSC record for every line

title: Copied core diff script against Raspberry Pi's RP2350B minimal design
procedure: write board/tools/check_core.py: netlist and geometry diff of the copied core (pads, vias, VREG_LX copper, decoupling) against RP-010329; the by-hand overlay at ORDER is VER-23's
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences; the second 4.7 uF on +1V1 question answered in writing
